assessments.reasoning: The designated OSI terms record supplies the publisher's operative paragraphs. Its reported [344,2702) binding agrees with the frozen digest. Reading the definition, grant and condition together identifies both the required notices and the material that must carry them. The four distribution cases preserve those boundaries.

challenge.method: Applied the condition to a complete covered copy, a substantial covered portion, unrelated material shipped alongside either, and an excerpt of disputed substantiality.
challenge.results: Both notices are required in the first two cases. Shipping unrelated material alongside the Software does not itself bring that material within the definition. The excerpt cannot be classified from the form alone.

limitations: A disputed excerpt requires facts about what was taken and its relation to the covered material. The form supplies no numerical threshold or prescribed packaging method.
The claim establishes neither rights to republish a license representation nor the licensing of the License Index CLI or authority to grant rights in any particular work.
reasoning: The permission paragraph defines Software to include the covered software and its associated documentation files. The immediately following paragraph requires both notices in every copy or substantial portion of that Software. The copyright notice is the one preceding the grant, represented in the form by year and holder placeholders. The permission notice is the notice granting permission subject to the stated condition.
